integrity: An unrestricted elementary classification argument is supplied; exact finite checks are supplementary. Published Pascal-column integrality is explicitly credited and not presented as new. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to cubics with all three roots nonpositive integers, up to a scalar preserving integer values. It does not classify all integer-valued cubic polynomials or require all levels of the binomid pyramid to be integral.
title: A three-term recognition theorem for integer-root binomid cubics
